[[Bog Skale Blighter]]s are higher level Bog Skale usually found in southwestern Kryta.  They are often found in large groups with [[Bog Skale Icetooth|Bog Skale Iceteeth]] and can be quite dangerous to bunched up groups with their use of [[Putrid Explosion]].
